assets.caption: The scene is a bright, functional bathroom, captured in a realistic style, conveying a sense of practicality and accessibility. The overall tone is clean and reassuring, emphasizing user safety and comfort. A light beige tile floor extends throughout the entire space, providing a warm and neutral base. A white tub, equipped with sturdy grab bars, is centrally located on one wall, with a white shower chair positioned within it. Adjacent to the tub, a toilet is fitted with a safety frame, ensuring secure use. A solid black bath mat is placed directly in front of the tub and toilet, contrasting sharply with the light flooring. To the right of the toilet, a vanity sink with a light countertop and wooden cabinetry is a prominent feature, indicating a complete and functional bathroom setup. The walls are painted in a light, neutral color, complementing the beige tiles and white fixtures, and enhancing the bright atmosphere. The 360 scene is faultless.
